scientific_integrity: Infinite-family claim supported by a combinatorial proof; exhaustive checks for \(2\le n\le9\) and degree checks for \(4\le n\le200\) are finite corroboration, not a substitute. External validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: All-size polynomial applies to labeled matched-clique prisms \(K_2\square K_n\), for \(n\ge2\). No claim of general rook-graph coverage. A potentially relevant 2026 join-polynomial article was accessible only as an abstract; the complement of a complete prism is connected for \(n\ge3\).
title: Complete locating-total domination polynomial of the complete prisms \(K_2\square K_n\)
